description: List configured OpenClaw cron jobs. Wraps the gateway JSON-RPC method `cron.list`. Returns jobs with name, schedule, payload kind, and enabled state.

includeDisabled.description: Set true to include disabled jobs (alias for enabled='all')

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

query.description: Free-text search filter on job name

name: openclaw_cron_list
